# Multiplicities of the Eigenspaces of the Johnson Scheme $J(8,3)$

## Setup

The Johnson scheme $J(v,k)$ is an association scheme on the set $X = \binom{[v]}{k}$ of all $k$-subsets of $[v]=\{1,\dots,v\}$, with $|X|=\binom{v}{k}$. Two $k$-subsets $S,T$ are in relation $R_i$ (for $i=0,1,\dots,d$) when $|S\cap T|=k-i$, where $d=\min(k,\,v-k)$.

For $J(8,3)$: $v=8$, $k=3$, $d=\min(3,5)=3$, and $|X|=\binom{8}{3}=56$. So there are four relations $R_0,R_1,R_2,R_3$ (with $R_0$ the diagonal) and four eigenspaces $V_0,V_1,V_2,V_3$.

## The Multiplicity Formula

A standard result in the theory of the Johnson scheme (obtainable via the Eberlein/Hahn polynomials or the representation theory of the symmetric group acting on $k$-subsets) is:

$$m_\ell \;=\; \binom{v}{\ell}-\binom{v}{\ell-1}, \qquad \ell=0,1,\dots,d,$$

with the convention $\binom{v}{-1}=0$.

**Derivation sketch.** The Bose–Mesner algebra of $J(v,k)$ is the commutant of the permutation representation of $S_v$ on $\binom{[v]}{k}$. By Young's rule, this permutation representation decomposes as

$$\mathrm{Ind}_{S_k\times S_{v-k}}^{S_v}(\mathbf{1}) \;\cong\; \bigoplus_{\ell=0}^{d} S^{(v-\ell,\ell)},$$

where $S^{(v-\ell,\ell)}$ is the Specht module indexed by the two-row partition $(v-\ell,\ell)$, which exists for $0\le \ell\le \lfloor v/2\rfloor$, and in the scheme we restrict to $\ell\le d=\min(k,v-k)$. The multiplicity of $S^{(v-\ell,\ell)}$ — hence the dimension of the eigenspace $V_\ell$ — is the dimension of this Specht module:

$$\dim S^{(v-\ell,\ell)} \;=\; \binom{v}{\ell}-\binom{v}{\ell-1},$$

the number of standard Young tableaux of shape $(v-\ell,\ell)$, equivalently the hook-length count for a two-row diagram.

## Computation for $J(8,3)$

Applying the formula with $v=8$:

| $\ell$ | $\binom{8}{\ell}$ | $\binom{8}{\ell-1}$ | $m_\ell$ |
|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| 0 | $\binom{8}{0}=1$ | $0$ | $1$ |
| 1 | $\binom{8}{1}=8$ | $\binom{8}{0}=1$ | $7$ |
| 2 | $\binom{8}{2}=28$ | $\binom{8}{1}=8$ | $20$ |
| 3 | $\binom{8}{3}=56$ | $\binom{8}{2}=28$ | $28$ |

## Verification

Sum of multiplicities:
$$m_0+m_1+m_2+m_3 = 1+7+20+28 = 56 = \binom{8}{3}=|X|. \;\checkmark$$

The sum equals the total number of points, confirming these are all the eigenspaces and the multiplicities are correct.

## Result

The multiplicities of the eigenspaces of the Johnson scheme $J(8,3)$ are:

$$\boxed{m_0=1,\quad m_1=7,\quad m_2=20,\quad m_3=28.}$$

### PROOF COMPLETE
